newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound interbank rates higher, market flush.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound interbank rates higher, market flush.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the pound rose in an unusually liquid Sunday private-sector market to between 9-1/4 and 10 percent from Thursday's low rates ranging from eight and 8-3/4 percent, bankers said.

They said several banks did not get what they had asked for in the central bank's auction of 800 million pound worth of treasury bills last Wednesday. The market is normally tight at the beginning of the trading week.
One-week rates were also higher at between 9-1/2 and 10 percent from Thursday's range of between 8-3/4 and nine percent.
Public-sector banks kept rates steady at 10-1/2 percent.
